value: The headline setting keeps no path rule: skipping elites is worth up to +14 HP and the HP-40 rule +1.53 HP, but with no elite payoff on this gauntlet any path rule would bias the yardstick; --elites skip|hp stay as flags and path choice stays on the run-layer list.

sources.anchor: Elite-skip read: path choice is real, the headline keeps no path rule (owner away, 2026-11-02)

confirms.note: yardstick/headline-setting rev 2 changed only which depth judges a change (one turn; the two-turn product is the reported score); the setting's flags this fact relies on (--start starter --rewards sim --sim-boss, 500 sequences) are unchanged
